title: What do you think about my steam capsule ?
author: NG1Chuck
selftext: This is for a fast RTS micro focused (game under 10 minutes ) with 1v1 2v2 1v1v1 and a solo/coop with extraction

replies.author: gfe_TheHouse
replies.body: Expanding on this - AI loves the red vs blue motif with banners and the same type of fading into the distance.

replies.author: NG1Chuck
replies.body: The game is really red vs blue and asset are not AI 😭

replies.author: gfe_TheHouse
replies.body:
Ask your favorite AI to build a steam capsule where a red team and blue team are opposed and see what you get. 

Unfortunately, it's going to scream AI even if you hand drew this layout. Imo. I'm not an expert just a guy online.

comments.author: Fuzzzy420
comments.body:
I don't get why you still invest in the idea. I saw the gameplay and the assets from tiny swords. I'm sorry but there is no game here. It's just ai slop. It has nothing to do with the title of the game. There is no real time strategy, it's just A stale world and a unit producing castle. You can barely see the units fighting and why are they fighting anyways. 

How much money have you spent on this? 

Sorry to be so negative
